context.description: Supervisors record only facts the progress alphabet allows

evidence.trustReason: Fresh-context review at HEAD 5fb09be29c (after D8/D9 fixes in supervise/run.ts and harness.ts); test unchanged since 6841bc0e5d; trial bun test 4 pass 0 fail. Given each unit kind in each state: three real /task runs in seeded git instances (real command, harness root, Recorder, run/task/scenario supervisors, workers, proofs, merges; only the session side is scripted and it acts through the real hook routing) cover leaf ready/building/proving/verifying, parent ready/verifying, scenario ready/verifying, outside waiting and external waiting, asserted exactly by the covered-states lists; stray verdicts, stray task_ready and repetition hooks, silent turns (nudges), an unready proof, a repetition, a budget exhausted with blocked units, forwarded and ignored trusts, two spec checks and a cancel are driven. When its supervisor records a fact: every stored fact is replayed through the real pure fold and checked against the real TaskAlphabet.alphabet of the snapshot just before it (same type, same unit; AD-7 payloads are abstract). Then the fact is in the alphabet or an exception: zero NOT ALLOWED in every run; the exceptions used are exactly the Gherkin's (run.started, task.nudged x2, spec.checked x2, run.cancelled), asserted as exact lists; test 3 asserts the full ordered fact list. A negative control shows the check refuses out-of-state facts (a verdict while building, a proof of a waiting task, a start of a waiting task, a judged waiting scenario) and a late external trust. Open wording note decided: the external-region trust passes as start-up only in the real start-up step (after run.started, the region untrusted, and only when the empty-log alphabet holds it). The spine (AD-7, AD-15, fact table) and the alphabet's own definition put that trust in the alphabet 'in the start-up step'; run.started is itself a listed exception and does not move the region, so the start-up state of the region is the one whose alphabet holds the trust. The test's reading meets the Gherkin; the Gherkin could still name it (wording only, kept in scenario-findings.md). Not exercised but allowed by the list: run.resumed, run.ended, obligation.stale; task.failed/needs_human are in every active-state alphabet and are not exercised here (SV6 covers task.failed).
